paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想作为顶会 Oral Presentation、组会汇报或博士面试 PPT 第一页的开场白：在 45–60 秒内不用任何晦涩公式，让全场听众立刻听懂“我们为什么要做这件事、现有方法到底卡在哪”。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Concrete Visual Scenario -> Rhetorical Question -> Crisp Culprit Identification -> Talk Promise. 绑定逻辑规则：L018, L029.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Good morning everyone. Suppose you are operating a regional wind-power grid when a sudden cold front sweeps across the turbines. Standard Transformer forecasters look accurate during calm weather, yet why do their predictions lag by hours right when the storm hits? The culprit is instance normalization: in trying to stabilize attention weights, it strips away the exact amplitude surges needed to predict peak loads. In the next five minutes, I will show how our model, DyTS-Net, resolves this trade-off—cutting extreme-weather forecasting error by 17% while running twice as fast.

paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想说明：把我们的核心思想落地时遇到了两个具体工程/数学难点，我们分别设计了什么精巧机制去攻克它们。

paragraphs.paragraph_en: Instantiating closed-loop visuomotor diffusion on physical robots entails two technical challenges. First, because raw depth camera streams contain occlusion artifacts around reflective object edges, we introduce a tactile-guided cross-attention gate that reweights visual tokens upon contact onset. Second, to eliminate the 200 ms sampling bottleneck of iterative denoising, we formulate a trajectory consistency distillation objective that maps Gaussian noise directly to collision-free action chunks in two forward steps. Together, these designs sustain 50 Hz reactive control under partial visual occlusion.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 具身智能专属：多模态感知-动作闭环与 Sim-to-Real 阐述段（Embodied AI Policy）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想阐述具身智能机器人策略（Embodied Policy）如何融合视觉、本体感觉（Proprioception）或触觉，并克服仿真到真实硬件的动力学差距（Sim-to-Real Gap）。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Visual Occlusion Bottleneck -> Asynchronous Multimodal Alignment -> Action Chunking -> Online Sim-to-Real System Identification. 绑定逻辑规则：L025, L003.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Relying solely on third-person RGB-D observations leaves visuomotor policies vulnerable to severe self-occlusion once the gripper approaches the target object. To preserve observability during contact-rich manipulation, our encoder aligns 30 Hz visual spatial tokens with 500 Hz joint proprioception and wrist force-torque histories via cross-modal rotary embeddings. Rather than issuing single-step commands prone to high-frequency jitter, the policy predicts 16-step SE(3) end-effector action chunks smoothed through exponential temporal ensembling. At deployment, a recurrent history adapter estimates latent surface friction and payload mass online, bridging the sim-to-real dynamics gap in zero shot.

paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想说明我们的模型不仅准，而且算得快、显存省，在“精度-延迟/显存”帕累托前沿（Pareto Frontier）上显著优于现有大模型。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Hardware Benchmark -> Complexity Reduction & Memory Gain -> Real-Time Latency Margin -> Pareto Conclusion. 绑定逻辑规则：L010, L023.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Figure 6 plots the MSE-latency Pareto frontier measured on an onboard NVIDIA Orin AGX module. By replacing $O(L^2)$ point-wise self-attention with $O(L \log L)$ spectral filtering and compact patch tokens, DyTS-Net reduces peak GPU memory by 62% and training wall-clock time by 3.4x compared with iTransformer. At inference time, generating a 16-step visuomotor trajectory requires only 6.8 ms—well below the 20 ms cycle budget of a 50 Hz industrial robot controller—while outperforming a 200 ms DDPM baseline by 11.4% in task success rate.
